name: Tony's Pizzaria
bio: Tony's Pizzaria is a family-run pizzeria on East Thompson Boulevard near Surfers Point in Ventura, open since 1959. It has an eat-in patio, outdoor games and a fire pit.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from tonyspizzaria.net and @tonys_pizzaria.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
